transcript.content: Hello, please have a seat. What brings you in to see me today?

I’m here because my husband’s family has been quietly interfering with our money and our reputation for months. Little billing errors come up at work, or people at church start acting strange toward me. Everyone says there’s no proof in the records, but I know it all traces back to them.
Have you ever heard voices or sounds that other people couldn't hear?
No, I haven’t noticed hearing voices or sounds that other people couldn’t hear.
Over the past few weeks or months, have you been feeling persistently down, sad, or hopeless?
I’m not sure I’d call it persistently down or hopeless. I’ve been frustrated and worried, but I still get through my days.
Have you ever had periods where you felt unusually energetic, wired, or on top of the world?
No, I don’t think so. I’ve had stress and worry, but not periods where I felt unusually energized or on top of the world.
Do you ever feel like thoughts that are not your own are being placed into your mind by an outside force?
No, I don’t feel like outside forces are putting thoughts into my mind.
Looking back across your life, has being distrustful or suspicious of others generally been a pattern for you, even before these issues with your in-laws began?
I’m not sure. I mean, I’ve had times I was cautious about people, but I don’t know that I’d say it’s been a general pattern my whole life.
Do you feel there is any chance you could be mistaken about your in-laws being behind these events, or are you completely certain?

No, I’m completely certain. It’s been going on for months—little billing errors at work, people at church treating me differently—and it all connects back to my husband’s family. I know what the records may say, but they’re involved.
